page.overview:
Who is Dylan Cooper?

Dylan Cooper is a minor character in Into the Pit, the first story from Fazbear Frights 1: Into the Pit, and a secondary antagonist in the video game adaptation. He's a bully at Oswald's school that enjoys picking on others.

In the book, Dylan is only described as "the tallest kid in fifth grade," who clearly enjoyed looming over others. In the game, he has short brown hair, pale skin, and a gray baseball cap. He has a gray jacket, red t-shirt with a gray skull on it, baggy jeans, and blue shoes.

Dylan is a bully, who enjoys picking on others. He likes being tall so that he can look down everyone. He has been bothering Oswald since preschool, and "was the kind of kid who'd pick on anything that made you different."

Dylan Cooper is a bully at Westbrook Elementary and Westbrook Middle School, picking on anything that made others different. He is roughly ten years old as of the plot of Into the Pit. When he was in preschool, there was a cartoon about a big pink ocelot named Oswald, which lead to Dylan and his friends calling Oswald "Oswald the Ocelot." In fifth grade, they were taught about Lee Harvey Oswald in U.S. history, leading to worse name-calling from Dylan.
